Work across the full Linux stack from kernel through GUI to optimise Ubuntu, the world's most widely used Linux desktop and server, for the latest silicon.

  • Design and implement the best Ubuntu integration for the latest IoT and server-class hardware platforms and software stacks

  • You love technology and working with brilliant people
  • You have a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, STEM or similar
  • You have experience with Linux packaging (Debian, RPM, Yocto)
  • You have experience working with open source communities and licences
  • You have experience working with C, C++
  • You can work in a globally distributed team through self-discipline and self-motivation.
Additional Skills That You Might Also Bring
  • Experience with graphics stacks
  • Good understanding of networking - TCP/IP, DHCP, HTTP/REST
  • Basic understanding of security best practices in IoT or server environments
  • Good communication skills, ideally public speaking experience
  • IoT / Embedded experience – from board and SoC, BMCs, bootloaders and firmware to OS, through apps and services
  • Some experience with Docker/OCI containers/K8s

title: Software Engineer - Cross-platform C++ - Multipass
description:
Software Engineer - Cross-platform C++ - Multipass

Use your deep C++ skills on Windows and MacOS to build an amazing open source developer experience with Multipass, the workstation mini-cloud at your fingertips which provides Ubuntu and appliance VMs on demand for build, test and prototyping. The Multipass team is hiring a Software Engineer to join our distributed team. We greatly value quality in our code, and great user experience.

Multipass is published for macOS, Windows, and also Linux. Think of it as a workstation mini-cloud. At its simplest you can simply say multipass launch and you will get a new VM on your workstation. You can feed that VM data, just as you would on a public cloud like AWS, Azure or GCP.

The goal is not to be a full cloud of course. The goal is to give developers a local cloud on their workstation, which they can use to run builds in the background, or to try cloud appliances, or to test their own cloud deployments and cloud-init scripts, free of charge. People sometimes use it as a build farm on a shared server, for example.

As a Software Engineer you are expected to play a leadership role designing, mentoring, reviewing and of course coding.

Location : This is a remote position available in the EMEA region only.

What you will focus on

  • Ensure Multipass is easy and intuitive to use
  • Architect new features and design the user experience
  • Write high-quality code to create new features and fix bugs
  • Review code and architecture as part of Canonical's engineering process
  • Collaborate proactively with a distributed team
  • Debug, track down and fix issues encountered by our users
  • Foster the open source community and support customers when needed
  • Travel internationally for up to two weeks, twice a year, for company events

What we are looking for in you

  • Cross-platform development experience on macOS and/or Windows
  • Expertise in modern C++ development
  • Experience with software testing and test-driven development
  • Extremely high personal standards for code quality, testing and design
  • Knowledge of hypervisor technologies such as Hyper-V, VirtualBox, KVM, and QEMU
  • Open source experience and involvement
  • Knowledge of CI systems a plus
  • Capacity to learn quickly about new systems and techniques
  • Excellent communication skills in English - both verbal and written
  • Bachelor's or equivalent in Computer Science, STEM or similar degree

What we offer you

  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events

As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world on a daily basis. Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder led, profitable and growing.
As the Software Engineering Manager for Ubuntu Gaming, your mission is to help make gaming on Ubuntu first-class. In this exciting time for Linux gaming, compatibility tools like Proton have matured, but a well-rounded gaming experience goes beyond compatibility. It entails maximising performance, robust and secure anti-cheat mechanisms, full device support, and ease of content creation, sharing and discovery. By collaborating with open-source projects and other partners, you'll contribute to not just Ubuntu but the wider Linux gaming ecosystem.
Location: This role will be based remotely in the Americas or EMEA region.
The role entails

  • Leading your team in optimising and expanding the Ubuntu gaming experience, focusing on the Steam Snap.
  • Managing project timelines, balancing feature improvements with deadlines.
  • Collaborating with stakeholders to align your team's work with other teams and company objectives.
  • Conducting keen-eyed code reviews, focusing on quality, performance, and modern design principles.
  • Collaborating with upstream projects like Proton and partners like Unity to enhance Ubuntu's gaming capabilities.
  • Working closely with other teams to ensure a cohesive and comprehensive Ubuntu experience.
  • Driving performance improvements across a wide range of hardware.
  • Engaging actively with the open source and gaming community to gather feedback and collaborate on improvements.
What we are looking for in you
  • An undergraduate degree in a technical subject or a compelling narrative about your alternative chosen path.
  • Proven ability to collaborate effectively with upstream projects and partners.
  • Familiarity and experience with the Linux graphics stack spanning user-space components to low level kernel drivers.
  • Exceptional software project management skills, encompassing risk assessment and resource allocation.
  • Ability to balance technical leadership with effective team management.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills for both internal and external interactions.
  • Robust planning skills, demonstrated by your capacity to manage multi-cycle improvements.

Nice-to-have skills
  • A passion for technology and gaming, driving you to work with intelligent, motivated colleagues.

What we offer colleagues
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since its inception in 2004. title: Chief Operating Officer (COO)
description:
Overview

InPlanet is a mission-driven, remote-first ClimateTech startup with hubs in Sao Paulo, Rio de Janeiro, New York and London. We are scaling Enhanced Rock Weathering (ERW) in tropical agriculture to remove carbon, regenerate soils, and transform how food is grown in the tropics. Our vision is to sequester gigatons of CO2 while regenerating tropical soils to create a liveable planet with nutritious food and healthy ecosystems for future generations. We are partnering with farmers, scientists, and industry leaders and are growing fast. Our culture blends people-first care and performance excellence. The Rocket represents our ambition and drive; the Heart symbolizes our focus on empathy, integrity, and collective impact.

We are proud of our globally diverse team and inclusive culture. Our teams span across continents, but our boots are firmly on the ground in Brazil where the real climate impact happens.

About The Role

Role: COO to lead go-to-market strategy for novel mineral-based carbon removal products across agricultural and mining sectors, and to evolve our operational backbone. You will oversee the entire value chain—from mineral inputs and field operations to the internal science engine and technology roadmap. This is a senior role where bold strategy meets operational precision to drive transformational scale.

Location & Travel: Hybrid, with travel in Brazil. Language skills: Portuguese, English (fluent). Start date: Ideally Q3/Q4 2025.

Key Responsibilities

  • Define and scale a novel carbon removal product from early traction to national impact in agriculture and mining; a 1-100 leadership role requiring bold strategy and relentless execution.
  • Lead the design and execution of a world-class ERW deployment operation across Brazil with scalability in mind.
  • Translate carbon and climate goals into clear operational strategies and regional delivery models.
  • Drive continuous improvement via operational KPIs, systemisation, and data-driven performance.
  • Collaborate with the Chief Impact Officer, Head of Operations, and VP of Science to align field strategy with scientific standards and operational goals.
  • Lead the integration of field deployment, scientific integrity, and operational scaling to ensure product-market fit.
  • Build cross-functional alignment to ensure the product offers agronomic value while meeting carbon certification requirements; orchestrate the 1-100 scale-up journey.
  • Oversee the sourcing, logistics, and deployment of rock powder from mine to farm; ensure compliance with carbon standards and farmer requirements.
  • Support legal to uphold integrity in carbon reporting and environmental impact.
  • Lead a large and growing team across Brazil and globally; collaborate with Carbon, Science, and Technology teams and strategic partners.

Team & Culture

  • Build a leadership culture that is entrepreneurial, fast, and accountable; turn high performers into high-impact owners.
  • Lead, mentor, and grow high-performing operations teams across Brazil and globally.
  • Champion a culture of accountability, collaboration, and impact-driven execution.
  • Empower regional managers and technical leads to deliver quality projects at scale.

You can be a Rock-Star if you have

Core Skills & Experience

  • 10+ years of senior leadership in operations, supply chain, or agribusiness in Brazil and in high-growth or startup contexts.
  • You have scaled something from messy beginnings to market success—ideally as a founder, GM, or CEO. You know what product-market fit looks like, and how to turn it into category leadership.
  • Proven experience leading multidisciplinary teams and building scalable systems from the ground up.
  • Strong communication and negotiation skills in Portuguese and English.

Key Qualities

  • Visionary but pragmatic—able to balance long-term strategy with daily urgency.
  • A confident, emotionally intelligent leader who knows when to listen, act, and delegate.
  • Comfortable navigating complexity, ambiguity, and rapid growth.
  • Hands-on, humble, and willing to “get your boots dirty” when needed.
  • Passion for sustainability, tropical agriculture, and climate innovation.

Bonus Points

  • Experience in impact-driven sectors such as climate, carbon markets, or regenerative agriculture is a big plus.
  • Deep knowledge and network of Brazilian agriculture, logistics, or mining.
  • Experience building strategic and commercial partnerships in Brazil, within agriculture.
  • Experience with building and scaling tech for agriculture.

Living Our Values

  • Trust: You believe in being kind and transparent in the workplace, fostering trust and collaboration.
  • Drive: You possess an innate drive to take action with a hands-on, can-do attitude, propelled by urgency.
  • Impact: You dream big and are committed to making a meaningful difference in the world, aligning with our mission to address climate change.
  • Compensation: Competitive compensation philosophy discussed in the first interview to manage expectations fairly.
  • Share options to make you feel like an owner.
  • Home Office Budget; Hybrid Remote around Sao Paulo.
  • Language Programme Monthly Allowance.
  • 40 days annual leave.
  • The opportunity to be autonomous and belong to a vision.
  • Bi-annual offsites in Brazil.
  • Laptop to fuel your productivity.

Application Process

Roughly 8 hours across 4-6 weeks from CV-screening.

  • Interview with VP of People
  • Interview with the Hiring Manager (required core skills and competencies)
  • 1-2 more 1:1 interviews with core leaders
  • Panel with 4+ team members (specific task, preparation needed)
  • Verbal reference check and psychometric profiling
  • Offer

How To Apply

  • Submit your CV in English, as this is the main language used at InPlanet (Portuguese accepted if justified).

Join to apply for the Software Platform Engineering Manager - Ubuntu for Next-Gen Silicon role at Canonical

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.
We are hiring engineering managers who are passionate about operational systems, open source technologies and cutting-edge hardware to lead engineering teams to enable and optimize Ubuntu for the latest x86, ARM, RISC-V, s390x and POWER systems.
We partner with the world's leading silicon vendors to optimise Ubuntu on their latest platforms. We integrate next-generation features and performance enhancements in Ubuntu while also ensuring a common operating experience for their users.
Engineering Managers should be outstanding developers themselves. They should be completely at home reviewing a patch or a software design spec. You will be expected to drive healthy engineering practices, documentation, quality and performance optimisations as well as lead your team to deliver high-quality design and code.
An Engineering Manager is responsible for line management and career guidance. The ability to develop engineering talent, to represent your team and product from a technical perspective, and to drive collaboration with other teams and customers are all critical to success in this role.
You will have the opportunity to influence the culture, facilitate technical delivery, and work with your team on strategy and execution.
Location: This is a globally remote role. We have open positions in every time zone.
What your day will look like

  • Lead and develop a team of engineers, ranging from graduate to senior
  • Oversee commercial engagements and support timely delivery on agreed project milestones
  • Participate as technical lead on complex customer engagements involving complete system architectures
  • Implement disciplined engineering processes
  • Integrate and maintain platform-oriented software stacks
  • Optimize Ubuntu for latest hardware platforms
  • Display technical leadership internally and within our external communities
  • Contribute to code reviews and technical documentation
  • Be an active part of the leadership team, collaborating with other leaders
What we are looking for in you
  • Exceptional academic track record from both high school and university
  • Undergraduate degree in Computer Science or STEM, or a compelling narrative about your alternative path
  • Fluency in C, C++, and Python
  • Experience with Linux and operational systems software (e.g. kernel or user space)
  • Experience with Debian/Ubuntu or other distro packaging
  • Experience leading software engineering teams
  • Professional written and spoken English
  • Confidence to respectfully speak up, exchange feedback, and share ideas without hesitation
  • Thoughtfulness, and self-motivation
  • Result-oriented, with a personal drive to meet commitments
  • Ability to travel internationally twice a year for company events up to two weeks long
Nice-to-have skills
  • Experience working with open source communities and licenses
  • Computer architecture knowledge of x86, ARM, RISC-V or s390x
  • Understanding of build systems and toolchains, including for cross-compilation
  • Experience working with customers
  • Experience with board bring up and validation
  • Experience with Linux virtualization, networking or graphics stacks
  • Experience with one or more of the follow
  • Experience with Docker/OCI containers/K8s
  • ing technologies: confidential computing, RDMA, Infiniband and high performance computing.
  • Performance engineering, benchmarking and profiling
What we offer you
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events
About Canonical
Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world on a daily basis. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Canonical has been a remote-first company since its inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.
Canonical is an equal opportunity employer
We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

description:
Software Platform Engineering Manager - Ubuntu for Next-Gen Silicon

2 months ago Be among the first 25 applicants

Get AI-powered advice on this job and more exclusive features.

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.
We are hiring engineering managers who are passionate about operational systems, open source technologies and cutting-edge hardware to lead engineering teams to enable and optimize Ubuntu for the latest x86, ARM, RISC-V, s390x and POWER systems.
We partner with the world's leading silicon vendors to optimise Ubuntu on their latest platforms. We integrate next-generation features and performance enhancements in Ubuntu while also ensuring a common operating experience for their users.
Engineering Managers should be outstanding developers themselves. They should be completely at home reviewing a patch or a software design spec. You will be expected to drive healthy engineering practices, documentation, quality and performance optimisations as well as lead your team to deliver high-quality design and code.
An Engineering Manager is responsible for line management and career guidance. The ability to develop engineering talent, to represent your team and product from a technical perspective, and to drive collaboration with other teams and customers are all critical to success in this role.
You will have the opportunity to influence the culture, facilitate technical delivery, and work with your team on strategy and execution.
Location: This is a globally remote role. We have open positions in every time zone.
What your day will look like

  • Lead and develop a team of engineers, ranging from graduate to senior
  • Oversee commercial engagements and support timely delivery on agreed project milestones
  • Participate as technical lead on complex customer engagements involving complete system architectures
  • Implement disciplined engineering processes
  • Integrate and maintain platform-oriented software stacks
  • Optimize Ubuntu for latest hardware platforms
  • Display technical leadership internally and within our external communities
  • Contribute to code reviews and technical documentation
  • Be an active part of the leadership team, collaborating with other leaders
What we are looking for in you
  • Exceptional academic track record from both high school and university
  • Undergraduate degree in Computer Science or STEM, or a compelling narrative about your alternative path
  • Fluency in C, C++, and Python
  • Experience with Linux and operational systems software (e.g. kernel or user space)
  • Experience with Debian/Ubuntu or other distro packaging
  • Experience leading software engineering teams
  • Professional written and spoken English
  • Confidence to respectfully speak up, exchange feedback, and share ideas without hesitation
  • Thoughtfulness, and self-motivation
  • Result-oriented, with a personal drive to meet commitments
  • Ability to travel internationally twice a year for company events up to two weeks long
Nice-to-have skills
  • Experience working with open source communities and licenses
  • Computer architecture knowledge of x86, ARM, RISC-V or s390x
  • Understanding of build systems and toolchains, including for cross-compilation
  • Experience working with customers
  • Experience with board bring up and validation
  • Experience with Linux virtualization, networking or graphics stacks
  • Experience with one or more of the follow
  • Experience with Docker/OCI containers/K8s
  • ing technologies: confidential computing, RDMA, Infiniband and high performance computing.
  • Performance engineering, benchmarking and profiling
What we offer you
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events
About Canonical
Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world on a daily basis. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Canonical has been a remote-first company since its inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.
Canonical is an equal opportunity employer
We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

  • Conducting keen-eyed code reviews, focusing on quality, performance, and modern design principles.

Overview

Vaga para o time de Pós-Vendas Automotivo.

Buscamos pessoas que assim como a gente, sejam inovadoras, práticas, objetivas, tenham paixão pelo que fazem e visem a excelência. Então, você se encaixa neste perfil?

Responsabilidades

  • Gestão das operações diárias de serviço Pós-Venda das concessionárias, melhorando suas capacidades de gestão;
  • Controle e feedback dos projetos de pós-venda das concessionárias, garantindo que os projetos sejam concluídos no prazo e com qualidade;
  • Participar da organização e apresentação de reuniões periódicas de atendimento Pós-Venda, compartilhando experiências e discutindo o progresso;
  • Participar da gestão de canais de Pós-Venda, incluindo a implantação e atualização do atendimento, de acordo com os padrões BYD;
  • Realizar o acompanhamento dos principais KPIs de Pós-Venda junto às concessionárias, desenvolvendo planos de ação para atingimento dos objetivos;
  • Participar na gestão de políticas de peças e acessórios, bem como na formulação e controle de políticas de preços.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Ensino Superior Completo em Engenharia, Administração de empresas ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência profissional na área automotiva.
  • Conhecimentos em Excel e pacote Office.
  • Desejável Inglês intermediário.
  • Disponibilidade para viagens frequentes nível Brasil.
  • Pode residir em qualquer região do Brasil.

Informações adicionais

  • Aqui na BYD priorizamos o bem-estar de nossos colaboradores e estamos em busca constante de melhorias para o nosso pacote de benefícios. Seu pacote vai contar com:
  • Convênio médico e odontológico coparticipativo para você e seus dependentes;
  • Programas de saúde e bem-estar para a melhoria da sua qualidade de vida;
  • Cartão Golden Farma para compras em farmácias cadastradas com desconto diretamente em folha, valendo tanto para medicamentos como para itens de higiene e beleza;
  • Gympass para cuidar da sua saúde física e mental;
  • Vale Refeição;
  • Vale Alimentação para te ajudar nas compras do mês;
  • Vale combustível;
  • Trabalhamos com horário flexível, para melhor organização da sua vida pessoal;
  • Licença maternidade de 6 meses e licença paternidade de 20 dias, além de um Kit Maternidade para o seu bebê;
  • Seguro de vida coletivo Porto Seguro, sem desconto em folha;
  • Auxílio creche para dependentes até 2 anos, conforme regras de elegibilidade.

A BYD (Build Your Dreams) é uma empresa de alta tecnologia que tem a missão de criar inovações tecnológicas para uma vida melhor. Fundada em 1995, contamos com mais de 30 parques industriais e estamos presentes em mais de 70 países, provendo excelência nas indústrias de eletrônicos, automóveis, energia limpa e transporte.

A BYD está comprometida com o desenvolvimento sustentável com seus valores de excelência, pragmatismo, paixão e inovação na promoção da geração de energia, armazenamento eficiente e mobilidade elétrica. Estamos presentes no Brasil desde 2015, com unidades em Campinas, São Paulo, Manaus e agora em Camaçari.

Nós nos dedicamos à fabricação de painéis solares, baterias e chassis de ônibus elétricos, e em breve a produção de automóveis híbridos plug-in e elétricos na nossa fábrica em Camaçari, na Bahia. Comercializamos também automóveis, caminhões, furgões, máscaras descartáveis e empilhadeiras elétricas, além de termos um projeto de Skyrail em São Paulo, onde forneceremos trens e sistemas para a Linha 17 – Ouro do Metrô de São Paulo.

Se você, assim como a gente, é prático, objetivo, inovador, apaixonado pelo que faz e focado em excelência, venha se juntar ao nosso time e faça parte da construção de um futuro mais verde! Então, você se encaixa neste perfil?

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. title: Senior Product Manager with Project Expertise
description:
Senior Product Manager with Project Expertise

Join to apply for the Senior Product Manager with Project Expertise role at ArcTouch .

ArcTouch is a specialty studio that is part of the award-winning AKQA Group. For over 15 years, ArcTouch has created lovable apps, websites, and connected experiences for world-class companies, leading brands, and innovative startups.

Know the Product Management Team

As a Senior PM, you'll have an exciting opportunity to work in a rapidly growing organization at the center of innovation. The Senior PM ensures product excellence and market success by mastering advanced product management practices while maintaining essential project management capabilities. By focusing on strategic vision and customer-centric innovation, we aim to turn our clients into HEROES. The Senior PM shapes product strategy, identifies market opportunities, and creates products that delight users and drive business growth. Responsibilities include developing long-term client relationships, creating product strategies aligned with business goals, running discovery workshops, building data-driven roadmaps, gathering market insights, defining innovative requirements, implementing product metrics, and maintaining essential project management functions such as sprint planning and budget monitoring. The Senior PM also evangelizes product vision across the organization and serves as the voice of the customer.

The ideal candidate will have extensive product management experience with a track record of successful digital product launches and strategic initiatives. You should be able to create compelling product visions, make data-driven recommendations based on market analysis, and build lasting client relationships. You should also balance strategic product thinking with fundamental project management responsibilities.

Role expectations

  • Be an ambassador for product excellence, customer-centricity, and strategic thinking
  • Use advanced product management expertise to drive innovation and market success
  • Run on-site and remote discovery workshops
  • Build and maintain long-term strategic relationships with key clients
  • Create compelling product strategies aligned with business objectives
  • Develop data-driven roadmaps based on market insights and customer research
  • Lead hypothesis validation and iterative product development
  • Identify expansion opportunities and new business potential
  • Define and refine requirements through collaborative client engagement
  • Maintain essential project management functions, including sprint planning and budget monitoring; facilitate ceremonies; manage risks and dependencies
  • Implement product metrics that validate hypotheses and measure success
  • Drive creative solutions without being constrained by previous approaches
  • Navigate organizational silos and build political capital within client businesses
  • Manage product lifecycle from concept through launch and beyond

On a typical day, you will

  • Engage with clients on product strategy and long-term vision
  • Gather and synthesize customer feedback into actionable requirements
  • Create and update strategic product roadmaps
  • Define product metrics and plan data collection strategies
  • Lead creative brainstorming sessions based on product vision
  • Validate hypotheses through data analysis and user research
  • Identify and pursue expansion opportunities with existing clients
  • Facilitate requirements definition workshops with stakeholders
  • Prioritize features based on business value and customer impact
  • Manage sprint planning and capacity allocation for your products
  • Monitor basic project metrics and budget utilization
  • Communicate product vision across cross-functional teams
  • Navigate client organizational dynamics to drive product adoption
  • Balance short-term delivery with long-term strategic objectives
  • Maintain product documentation and competitive analysis

Benefits

  • Remote work
  • Health, dental and life insurances
  • Meal allowance
  • Mental Health Program
  • Wellhub partnership
  • SESC partnership
  • Extended maternity, paternity and adopting leaves
  • Flexible benefits: wellness, courses, events, child care and more
  • Flexible hours

Why work for us? We love what we do. Check out our employee reviews on Glassdoor to learn why they love working for ArcTouch. ArcTouch is an Equal Opportunity Employer (EOE). Applicants are considered for employment without regard to age, race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity and gender expression, disability or veteran status.

Why should you join dLocal?

dLocal enables the biggest companies in the world to collect payments in 40 countries in emerging markets. Global brands rely on us to increase conversion rates and simplify payment expansion effortlessly. As both a payments processor and a merchant of record where we operate, we make it possible for our merchants to make inroads into the world’s fastest-growing, emerging markets.

By joining us you will be a part of an amazing global team that makes it all happen, in a flexible, remote-first culture with travel, health, and learning benefits, among others.   • dLocal Houses for remote coworking weeks worldwide.

  • Experiência fundadora ou empreendedora prévia: ter (co)fundado uma empresa que, independentemente de seu sucesso, conseguiu desenvolver um produto, gerar receita e conquistar clientes.

Esta não é uma lista exaustiva de requisitos. Buscamos pessoas movidas por intensa motivação e prontas para enfrentar os desafios da jornada empreendedora. Procuramos não apenas colaboradores, mas parceiros comprometidos com a jornada de construir algo do zero, vivenciando tanto os momentos estratégicos quanto os operacionais, sempre com foco no sucesso da empresa.

description:
Software Engineering Manager, Ubuntu Gaming

3 days ago Be among the first 25 applicants

Get AI-powered advice on this job and more exclusive features.

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1100+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder led, profitable and growing.
As the Software Engineering Manager for Ubuntu Gaming, your mission is to help make gaming on Ubuntu first-class. In this exciting time for Linux gaming, compatibility tools like Proton have matured, but a well-rounded gaming experience goes beyond compatibility. It entails maximising performance, robust and secure anti-cheat mechanisms, full device support, and ease of content creation, sharing and discovery. By collaborating with open-source projects and other partners, you'll contribute to not just Ubuntu but the wider Linux gaming ecosystem.
Location: This role will be based remotely in the Americas or EMEA region.
The role entails

  • Leading your team in optimising and expanding the Ubuntu gaming experience, focusing on the Steam Snap.
  • Managing project timelines, balancing feature improvements with deadlines.
  • Collaborating with stakeholders to align your team's work with other teams and company objectives.
  • Conducting keen-eyed code reviews, focusing on quality, performance, and modern design principles.
  • Collaborating with upstream projects like Proton and partners like Unity to enhance Ubuntu's gaming capabilities.
  • Working closely with other teams to ensure a cohesive and comprehensive Ubuntu experience.
  • Driving performance improvements across a wide range of hardware.
  • Engaging actively with the open source and gaming community to gather feedback and collaborate on improvements.
What we are looking for in you
  • An undergraduate degree in a technical subject or a compelling narrative about your alternative chosen path.
  • Proven ability to collaborate effectively with upstream projects and partners.
  • Familiarity and experience with the Linux graphics stack spanning user-space components to low level kernel drivers.
  • Exceptional software project management skills, encompassing risk assessment and resource allocation.
  • Ability to balance technical leadership with effective team management.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills for both internal and external interactions.
  • Robust planning skills, demonstrated by your capacity to manage multi-cycle improvements.
  • Ability to travel twice a year, for company events up to two weeks long
Nice-to-have skills
  • A passion for technology and gaming, driving you to work with intelligent, motivated colleagues.
  • Initiative in proactively identifying opportunities and solving challenges.
  • Curiosity, flexibility, and a strong sense of accountability.
  • A focus on soft skills, including passion, enterprise, and self-motivation.
What we offer colleagues
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events
About Canonical
Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since its inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.
Canonical is an equal opportunity employer
We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

Oportunidade para Gerente de Tributos Indiretos para o escritório de Campinas na EY.

Qual será o seu papel nesse propósito?

Como Gerente Tributário/a de Impostos Indireitos, você ajudará clientes a identificar áreas de risco e oportunidades de planejamento sustentável ao longo do ciclo de vida dos tributos indiretos, além de apoiar no cumprimento de obrigações de conformidade e metas de negócios.   • Desenvolver e manter relacionamentos produtivos com o cliente ao longo do ano, estabelecendo expectativas de valor;
  • Manter-se informado sobre desenvolvimentos econômicos e corporativos relevantes para o cliente;
  • Desenvolver pessoas, incentivando a responsabilidade pelas contribuições da equipe, delegando trabalho, conduzindo revisões de desempenho e fornecendo feedback/training;
  • Entender as linhas de serviço da EY e incentivar a participação da equipe na aplicação de serviços;
  • Manter cooperação com outras equipes e monitorar o progresso da equipe, ajustando o planejamento quando necessário;
  • Gerar novas oportunidades de negócio e apresentar formas de aplicar o conhecimento e os serviços da EY;
  • Desenvolver relacionamentos duradouros dentro e fora da empresa.

Por que você?

Se você atende aos requisitos abaixo, essa oportunidade pode ser sua:

  • Graduação em contabilidade, direito, administração ou economia;
  • Inglês avançado/fluente;
  • Profundo conhecimento em impostos indiretos (ICMS, IPI, PIS, COFINS e ISS);
  • Habilidades avançadas de comunicação verbal e escrita;
  • Habilidades de gestão de projetos;
  • Dedicação ao trabalho em equipe e à liderança.

Experiências desejáveis (diferenciais):

  • Experiência em compliance/planejamento, levantamento de créditos tributários, relatórios e consultas sobre questões tributárias, reestruturação de operações;
  • Experiência em auditoria, Compliance e Planejamento Tributário;
  • Propostas técnicas e desenvolvimento de novos negócios;
  • Conhecimento em Digital TAX.

O que oferecemos: Vale Alimentação, Vale Refeição, Vale Transporte, Plano de saúde, Assistência odontológica, Universidade Corporativa e outros benefícios, Gympass, PLR e mais. Saiba mais em go.ey.com/beneficios.

Quem somos

Somos uma das maiores empresas de serviços do mundo em Auditoria, Consultoria, Impostos, Estratégia e Transações, com presença em mais de 150 países. Oferecemos experiências excepcionais com alcance global, cultura inclusiva e tecnologia para desenvolver a sua melhor versão.

Join to apply for the Software Platform Engineering Manager - Ubuntu for Next-Gen Silicon role at Canonical

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.
We are hiring engineering managers who are passionate about operational systems, open source technologies and cutting-edge hardware to lead engineering teams to enable and optimize Ubuntu for the latest x86, ARM, RISC-V, s390x and POWER systems.
We partner with the world's leading silicon vendors to optimise Ubuntu on their latest platforms. We integrate next-generation features and performance enhancements in Ubuntu while also ensuring a common operating experience for their users.
Engineering Managers should be outstanding developers themselves. They should be completely at home reviewing a patch or a software design spec. You will be expected to drive healthy engineering practices, documentation, quality and performance optimisations as well as lead your team to deliver high-quality design and code.
An Engineering Manager is responsible for line management and career guidance. The ability to develop engineering talent, to represent your team and product from a technical perspective, and to drive collaboration with other teams and customers are all critical to success in this role.
You will have the opportunity to influence the culture, facilitate technical delivery, and work with your team on strategy and execution.
Location: This is a globally remote role. We have open positions in every time zone.
What your day will look like

  • Lead and develop a team of engineers, ranging from graduate to senior
  • Oversee commercial engagements and support timely delivery on agreed project milestones
  • Participate as technical lead on complex customer engagements involving complete system architectures
  • Implement disciplined engineering processes
  • Integrate and maintain platform-oriented software stacks
  • Optimize Ubuntu for latest hardware platforms
  • Display technical leadership internally and within our external communities
  • Contribute to code reviews and technical documentation
  • Be an active part of the leadership team, collaborating with other leaders
What we are looking for in you
  • Exceptional academic track record from both high school and university
  • Undergraduate degree in Computer Science or STEM, or a compelling narrative about your alternative path
  • Fluency in C, C++, and Python
  • Experience with Linux and operational systems software (e.g. kernel or user space)
  • Experience with Debian/Ubuntu or other distro packaging
  • Experience leading software engineering teams
  • Professional written and spoken English
  • Confidence to respectfully speak up, exchange feedback, and share ideas without hesitation
  • Thoughtfulness, and self-motivation
  • Result-oriented, with a personal drive to meet commitments
  • Ability to travel internationally twice a year for company events up to two weeks long
Nice-to-have skills
  • Experience working with open source communities and licenses
  • Computer architecture knowledge of x86, ARM, RISC-V or s390x
  • Understanding of build systems and toolchains, including for cross-compilation
  • Experience working with customers
  • Experience with board bring up and validation
  • Experience with Linux virtualization, networking or graphics stacks
  • Experience with one or more of the follow
  • Experience with Docker/OCI containers/K8s
  • ing technologies: confidential computing, RDMA, Infiniband and high performance computing.
  • Performance engineering, benchmarking and profiling
What we offer you
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events
About Canonical
Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world on a daily basis. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Canonical has been a remote-first company since its inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.
Canonical is an equal opportunity employer
We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

Procuramos alguém com perfil analítico, visão de negócios e liderança inspiradora, capaz de integrar a gestão de pessoas, processos e produto, garantindo performance da equipe e excelência operacional.
Observação: A vaga é remota, mas é necessário residir em São Paulo ou região metropolitana, pois há demandas presenciais relacionadas a visitas a clientes, participação em eventos e iniciativas estratégicas de expansão.
Principais Responsabilidades

  • Liderar uma unidade de negócios composta por accounts, assistentes, analistas de operação e sucesso do cliente B2B, além de RevOps.
  • Realizar rituais de gestão como 1:1s, feedbacks estruturados e acompanhamento de PDIs.
  • Monitorar a performance da equipe e dos indivíduos, incluindo controle de ponto e metas.
  • Apoiar nos processos de recrutamento, seleção e onboarding de novos talentos.
  • Planejar e acompanhar a execução dos projetos estratégicos trimestrais da área.
  • Garantir a entrega e evolução de indicadores-chave como revenue churn, net churn, MRR, upsell, cross-sell, margem operacional, entre outros.

  • Supervisionar entregas realizadas aos clientes e propor melhorias contínuas.
  • Identificar oportunidades de inovação com base em benchmarks e demandas do mercado.
  • Conduzir estratégias de relacionamento, retenção e expansão de receita, além de planos de recuperação e prevenção de churn com base no Health Score.

Requisitos Obrigatórios
  • Residir em São Paulo ou região metropolitana, com disponibilidade para visitas e participação em eventos presenciais.
  • Forte capacidade analítica para transformar dados em ações táticas e estratégicas.
  • Experiência com contas B2B Enterprise, especialmente com foco em expansão de receita.
  • Vivência com estratégias de retenção de clientes e crescimento sustentável.
  • Domínio de indicadores como MRR, churn, upsell, CSAT, Health Score e similares.
  • Experiência com feedbacks de clientes via app stores, Reclame Aqui, NPS e CSAT.
  • Perfil hands-on, com senso de urgência e foco em gerar valor ao cliente.
  • Fluência na comunicação (oral e escrita) e habilidade em conduzir reuniões remotas com objetividade e foco em resultado.
  • Experiência prévia liderando equipes multidisciplinares (CS, operações, atendimento, RevOps).
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas como CRM, planilhas avançadas, plataformas de BI e indicadores de performance.
  • Familiaridade com frameworks como OKRs, PDIs e metodologias ágeis.
  • Vivência em ambientes dinâmicos, como startups ou empresas em crescimento acelerado (high touch).
Diferenciais
  • Inglês ou espanhol em nível intermediário.
  • Experiência ou conhecimento em marketing digital e mídia de performance.
  • Conhecimento em HubSpot.

Resumo

Este profissional é responsável pela gestão de pessoas, coordena, treina, desenvolve e avalia a equipe. Realiza a gestão operacional do setor de padaria, sendo responsável pelas metas, resultados, ações de vendas e controles internos.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Gestão de Pessoas

  • Participar de processo seletivo, aplicações de medidas disciplinares entre outras situações envolvendo os colaboradores.
  • Administrar as folgas, horários e atestado dos Colaboradores.
  • Acompanhar e fiscalizar o uso de EPIs.
  • Definir as tarefas e prioridades dos colaboradores.
  • Avaliar os colaboradores aplicando feedback.
  • Realizar reuniões com a equipe informando sobre as metas, resultados das vendas comparando com a previsão e passando informações de recursos humanos.

Gestão Operacional

  • Atender clientes internos e externos.
  • Analisar o abastecimento de mercadorias, determinando as prioridades para colaboradores e promotores.
  • Confrontar as alterações de preços com o cartazeamento, a fim de confirmar se estão corretos.
  • Acompanhar constantemente o recebimento de mercadorias para orientar como fazer a estocagem apropriada, e as prioridades.
  • Acompanhar a produção e manipulação de produtos.
  • Acompanhar e analisar o desempenho das vendas e demais indicadores por meio de sistema e relatórios.
  • Realizar o balanço/inventário do setor.
  • Promover exposições e ações de vendas.
  • Realizar plantão de loja.
  • Realizar visitas em fornecedores para introdução de novos produtos.
  • Acompanhar e solicitar a compra e ou manutenção dos equipamentos da Padaria.

Requisitos e qualificações

Qualificações

  • Conhecimento em panificação e confeitaria, manipulação e higienização de alimentos e em negociação de vendas e compras
  • Será um diferencial: experiência em varejo, preferencialmente supermercadista

Requisitos

  • Desejável ensino superior completo e/ou cursando.
  • Habilidades com pacote Office em especial Excel.

Informações adicionais

Já falamos tudo o que esperamos de você, agora é hora de contar um pouco do que oferecemos para todos que fazem parte do nosso time:

Nossos Benefícios: Plano de saúde e odontológico referências em nossas áreas de atuação; Refeição na empresa com desconto de R$50,00 ao mês; Vale Transporte; Desconto nas Compras realizadas com o crachá; Convênio com Farmácias; Empréstimo Consignado entre outros benefícios que exigem maior tempo de casa.

E tem mais: O Enxuto investe constantemente em ações de desenvolvimento, oferece oportunidade para primeiro emprego, para profissionais experientes ou não, e prezamos pela diversidade, para nós o que importa é o Quere r, a Vontade de fazer o melhor todos os dias, o prazer em Servir e Encantar os nossos clientes internos e externos.

Prezamos por valorizar nossos talentos, por isso, constantemente divulgamos nossas oportunidades primeiramente para quem já faz parte do time, ou seja, você pode iniciar em uma área e ir aproveitando as oportunidades internas.

Importante: Nossos Valores são vividos no dia-a-dia e é crucial que você se identifique com eles: Honestidade, União, Respeito, Profissionalismo, Evolução e Responsabilidade Socioambiental. É a prática desses valores que garantirá que tenhamos uma história sólida onde todos saiam ganhando.

Desenvolvimento Estratégico de Serviços: Responsável pela formulação de estratégias abrangentes de serviço, assegurando a otimização contínua dos padrões operacionais e a melhoria dos processos de atendimento.

description:
Software Engineering Manager, Ubuntu Gaming

Software Engineering Manager, Ubuntu Gaming

2 days ago Be among the first 25 applicants

Join to apply for the Software Engineering Manager, Ubuntu Gaming role at Canonical

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1100+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder led, profitable and growing.
As the Software Engineering Manager for Ubuntu Gaming, your mission is to help make gaming on Ubuntu first-class. In this exciting time for Linux gaming, compatibility tools like Proton have matured, but a well-rounded gaming experience goes beyond compatibility. It entails maximising performance, robust and secure anti-cheat mechanisms, full device support, and ease of content creation, sharing and discovery. By collaborating with open-source projects and other partners, you'll contribute to not just Ubuntu but the wider Linux gaming ecosystem.
Location: This role will be based remotely in the Americas or EMEA region.
The role entails

  • Leading your team in optimising and expanding the Ubuntu gaming experience, focusing on the Steam Snap.
  • Managing project timelines, balancing feature improvements with deadlines.
  • Collaborating with stakeholders to align your team's work with other teams and company objectives.
  • Conducting keen-eyed code reviews, focusing on quality, performance, and modern design principles.
  • Collaborating with upstream projects like Proton and partners like Unity to enhance Ubuntu's gaming capabilities.
  • Working closely with other teams to ensure a cohesive and comprehensive Ubuntu experience.
  • Driving performance improvements across a wide range of hardware.
  • Engaging actively with the open source and gaming community to gather feedback and collaborate on improvements.
What we are looking for in you
  • An undergraduate degree in a technical subject or a compelling narrative about your alternative chosen path.
  • Proven ability to collaborate effectively with upstream projects and partners.
  • Familiarity and experience with the Linux graphics stack spanning user-space components to low level kernel drivers.
  • Exceptional software project management skills, encompassing risk assessment and resource allocation.
  • Ability to balance technical leadership with effective team management.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills for both internal and external interactions.
  • Robust planning skills, demonstrated by your capacity to manage multi-cycle improvements.
  • Ability to travel twice a year, for company events up to two weeks long
Nice-to-have skills
  • A passion for technology and gaming, driving you to work with intelligent, motivated colleagues.
  • Initiative in proactively identifying opportunities and solving challenges.
  • Curiosity, flexibility, and a strong sense of accountability.
  • A focus on soft skills, including passion, enterprise, and self-motivation.
What we offer colleagues
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events
About Canonical
Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since its inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.
Canonical is an equal opportunity employer
We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

title: Software Engineering Manager (Backend SaaS)
description:
Software Engineering Manager (Backend SaaS)

Join to apply for the Software Engineering Manager (Backend SaaS) role at Canonical

Software Engineering Manager (Backend SaaS)

3 days ago Be among the first 25 applicants

Join to apply for the Software Engineering Manager (Backend SaaS) role at Canonical

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.
We are hiring an engineering manager to lead the reboot of our Landscape systems management solution for Ubuntu.
Ubuntu is growing rapidly in the enterprise, with estates expanding from cloud, to bare metal servers, to vSphere clusters, and of course desktops and devices. Ubuntu is easy to deploy and configure, one node at a time, but it's difficult to know where you stand on policy and compliance, patch management, or access control across a large estate. Ubuntu used to be under the radar in the enterprise, but it is now becoming an official platform for many companies. Those enterprises very much want a high quality way to manage their Ubuntu estate.
We started work on Landscape many years ago, and the current generation of the service reflects the choices of the day. We now have the opportunity to invest significantly in a team to bring a fresh new vision for large-scale Ubuntu estate management to the project. That doesn't make this a greenfield opportunity - we have a system that serves thousands of deployments - but we know we want to step back and give it a big new push, letting go of some things that are no longer so important, and embracing a range of new priorities. This role is the critical engineering leadership role for that mission.
Today we use Python, PostgreSQL, RabbitMQ, HAProxy, and have a ReactJS front end. In other web services projects we use more Golang these days. Our next wave of Landscape engineering is an opportunity to raise the bar on SAAS and on-prem solution technologies, architectures, patterns and operations. Our goal is to make it easy for enterprises to own a few Landscape instances that serve their global estate, and to be able to apply policy and know intuitively where they stand - globally - in a very complex world of mixed Ubuntu versions, substrates and flavours.
Engineering managers at Canonical bring both technical and management skills to the leadership of their teams. You will work closely with product managers, and produce an engineering roadmap with ambitious and achievable goals. A successful applicant will be capable of growing a team of engineers, collaborating with other engineering and business teams at Canonical, and providing periodic updates about successes and areas of improvement.
As an engineering manager at Canonical you must be technically strong, but your responsibility is to run an effective team and develop the colleagues you manage. You are expected to help them grow as engineers, do important work, do it outstandingly well, find professional and personal satisfaction, and work well with colleagues and community. Technical leadership experience and a background in software engineering are necessary prerequisites for this role. You will be expected to lead, challenge, and develop strong engineers, positively influence the culture, facilitate technical delivery, and work with your team on strategy and execution.
We work in Python and Golang, and expect engineering managers to be fluent in the language, architecture and components that their team uses. Code reviews and architectural leadership are part of the job. As manager, the commitment to healthy engineering practices, documentation, quality and performance optimisation are equally important technical responsibilities, as is the requirement for fair and clear management, and the obligation to ensure a high performing team.

Valued Skills And Experience

O Operador de Equipamentos ficará responsável por realizar a operação de atendimento de rampa (movimentação de equipamentos motorizados ou não, embarque e desembarque de passageiros cadeirantes, transporte de bagagens e cargas entre as áreas operacionais do aeroporto) em aeronaves com segurança, qualidade e pontualidade, garantindo eficiência no processo e colaborando para a construção da percepção do cliente quanto aos serviços prestados pela empresa no que tange ao transporte de bagagens, cargas e pontualidade dos voos.

Esta é uma vaga exclusiva para o Aeroporto de Viracopos (VCP) !

Main responsibilities

  • Operar os equipamentos de rampa, realizando a movimentação segura de equipamentos rebocáveis no que tange à logística de preparação de box para atendimento dos voos com equipamentos necessários de acordo com a disponibilidade, levando-se em consideração o load factor, turn-around da aeronave, distribuição de cargas e bagagens nos porões;
  • Disponibilizar os equipamentos de GPU, ACU e LPU sempre que a aeronave estiver com APU inoperante e/ou para a execução do projeto smart fuel;
  • Realizar o transporte de bagagem e cargas entre variadas áreas de cada aeroporto que estão embarcando, desembarcando ou em conexão;
  • Garantir a segurança de todos durante o atendimento operacional;
  • Garantir a transferência das bagagens de conexão imediata (HOT) para as outras aeronaves;
  • Recolher os equipamentos do box após o término do atendimento.

Requirements and skills

  • Carteira Nacional de Habilitação (CNH) tipo D/E .
  • Visão analítica e sistemática, para tomadas de decisões;
  • Disponibilidade de horário;
  • Conhecimento em processo de atendimento ao cliente;

Nos aspectos físicos exigem-se coordenação motora ampla e fina, destreza, articulação dos membros superiores e dos inferiores, postura variável para desenvolvimento de suas atividades, rotação e flexão do tronco e esforço físico, locomoção e deambulação para desenvolvimento das tarefas.

Nos aspectos sensoriais exigem-se acuidade visual para condução dos veículos (atividade regulamentada pelo CTB – código de trânsito brasileiro) e percepção auditiva para detecção de sinais sonoros emergenciais.

Nos aspectos neuropsíquicos exigem-se atenção, concentração, habilidade organizacional, criatividade, interpretação de dados e iniciativa para solução de situações causais.

title: Software Engineering Manager (Backend SaaS)
description:
Software Engineering Manager (Backend SaaS)


Join to apply for the Software Engineering Manager (Backend SaaS) role at Canonical .



Overview


Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world\'s leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.



Role context


The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing. We are hiring an engineering manager to lead the reboot of our Landscape systems management solution for Ubuntu.



Ubuntu is growing rapidly in the enterprise, with estates expanding from cloud, to bare metal servers, to vSphere clusters, and of course desktops and devices. Ubuntu is easy to deploy and configure, one node at a time, but it\'s difficult to know where you stand on policy and compliance, patch management, or access control across a large estate. Ubuntu used to be under the radar in the enterprise, but it is now becoming an official platform for many companies. Those enterprises very much want a high quality way to manage their Ubuntu estate.



We started work on Landscape many years ago, and the current generation of the service reflects the choices of the day. We now have the opportunity to invest significantly in a team to bring a fresh new vision for large-scale Ubuntu estate management to the project. That doesn\'t make this a greenfield opportunity - we have a system that serves thousands of deployments - but we know we want to step back and give it a big new push, letting go of some things that are no longer so important, and embracing a range of new priorities. This role is the critical engineering leadership role for that mission.



Today we use Python, PostgreSQL, RabbitMQ, HAProxy, and have a ReactJS front end. In other web services projects we use more Golang these days. Our next wave of Landscape engineering is an opportunity to raise the bar on SAAS and on-prem solution technologies, architectures, patterns and operations. Our goal is to make it easy for enterprises to own a few Landscape instances that serve their global estate, and to be able to apply policy and know intuitively where they stand - globally - in a very complex world of mixed Ubuntu versions, substrates and flavours.



Responsibilities



  • Build and lead a team of engineers in your region

  • Develop talent through coaching, mentoring, feedback, and hands-on career development

  • Demonstrate sound engineering principles and directly contribute toward your team\'s goals

  • Set and manage expectations with other engineering teams, management, and external stakeholders

  • Lead modern, agile software development practices

  • Ensure a healthy, collaborative engineering culture in line with the company values

  • Be an active part of the leadership team and collaborate with other leaders in the organisation

  • Build automated, highly reliable image delivery, testing and publication pipelines

  • Engage with many other teams at Canonical, as well as the open source community and commercial partners

  • Work from home with global travel 4-6 weeks per year for internal and external events



Valued Skills And Experience



  • You love to mentor, develop and grow people, and have a track record of doing it

  • You are knowledgeable and passionate about software development

  • You are focused on success and the delivery of timely, high quality software

  • You have experience and commitment to agile development methodologies

  • You have a Bachelor\'s or equivalent in Computer Science, STEM or similar degree

  • Software development experience in Python or Golang

  • Effective written and verbal communication skills

  • Practical experience with Linux system administration



What we offer colleagues



  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person

  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year

  • Annual compensation review

  • Recognition rewards

  • Annual holiday leave

  • Maternity and paternity leave

  • Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform

  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues

  • Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long-haul company events



About Canonical


Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard. Most colleagues have worked from home since our inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.



Canonical is an equal opportunity employer. We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background creates a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.



Job details

  • Employment type: Full-time

  • Job function: Engineering and Information Technology

  • Industries: Software Development

O Agibank é para quem vive em eterna busca de conhecimento e não para mesmo quando tudo e todos jogam contra.

No Agibank, a vontade de crescer corre na veia, e quando essa vontade se junta, ela não pede licença. E o ambiente abre passagem para quem transforma caminho em estrada.

Juntos, lutamos por uma experiência bancária que acolhe e encoraja todos os brasileiros.
